description: Dependency update policy — roadmap 13.7, written up in docs/development.md §9.7. Every PR targets dev and has to pass the whole CI suite (typecheck, unit + coverage, integration, bundle budget, visual baselines) before anyone merges it; nothing auto-merges.

packageRules.description: devDependency patches and minors: one weekly PR for the lot.

The dashboard's stack moves together: a Vite major breaks Vitest and the React plugin, a Tailwind major breaks its Vite plugin, tailwind-merge and every shadcn primitive. Majors still get their own PR, separate from the minors (separateMajorMinor).
GitHub Actions patches and minors in one PR; a major (checkout v5 → v6) gets its own.
A Node major is a deliberate move with a checklist (docs/development.md §9.7), never a bot PR: .nvmrc, the Dockerfile's node:<major>-alpine, engines and @types/node change together, by hand.
engines.node is the floor npm enforces (engine-strict); it moves with the Node major, not on its own.
